subject: The GUI Text widget class, id 3, instance size 1F4h, vtable 00D5C6C8

packet_correction.finding: Neither address belongs to the Text class. They are the describe/read pair of a different widget class whose only property is an integer-keyed 'Points' array of GuiValueTag 6 (vec2) entries held in a begin/end pointer pair at +F0h/+F4h. 00AC2090 walks the pair; 00AC2DE0 probes ascending integer keys through the visitor's +14h predicate until it fails. That is the Curve class.
packet_correction.source_of_the_error: reports/gui_layout_loader.json followups[2] and the 'gui_text_properties' row in docs/GUI_LAYOUT_LOADER.md, which guessed the pair from the caller lists of 00AAA710 and 00AAAED0 without reading them.
packet_correction.how_the_real_class_was_reached: Class table id 3 -> constructor stub 00AA1380 -> allocator 00AB79E0 -> constructor 00AB9650, which passes the literal 3 to the base constructor 00AA9390 and installs the vtable 00D5C6C8. Virtual +18h is the reader 00ABB630 and virtual +1Ch is the describer 00AB7B60; both appear in the 13-caller lists the layout-loader doc printed.

+18h.role: read properties from the page table

+4Ch.role: set alpha; scales the shadow alpha

+50h.role: set colour; scales the shadow alpha by the colour w lane

+58h.role: set size, then force a text rebuild through 00ABB1D0

+64h.role: apply Align / VerticalAlign to a bounds rectangle

+70h.role: push clip parameters into the main and shadow drawables, then recurse

+74h.role: post-load hook: placeholder mesh and a zeroed local bounds

routines.name: BSP_GuiText_Construct
routines.behaviour: Calls 00AA9390 with the literal class id 3, installs the vtable 00D5C6C8 and writes every Text default listed in layout.fields, then calls 00AB8530 to ensure the draw sections.

routines.name: BSP_GuiText_ReadProperties
routines.behaviour: 00AAA710 for the base half, then Font (through 00AB8C30), FontScale, Multiline, DistanceBetweenLines, DefaultText (to a temporary), ShaderName, Align, VerticalAlign, the MISColors sub-table, DefaultShadow, and finally DefaultText through 00ABAED0 with the literal flag 1.

routines.name: BSP_GuiText_DescribeProperties
routines.behaviour: 00AAAED0 for the base half, then each Text property, emitted only when 00BD5680 reports it differs from the same default. Align and VerticalAlign are always emitted.

routines.name: BSP_GuiText_SetFontByName
routines.behaviour: Case-insensitive early-out against +1C8h. Otherwise caches the name, resolves it through BSP_FontSystem_GetRegistry and 00AC3570 into +108h, copies the record's +1Ch into +1D4h (1.0 on failure) and releases the cached shader at +1ECh. It does not re-run the layout.

routines.name: BSP_GuiText_ApplyShadowPreset
routines.behaviour: Early-out when +1D0h already holds the preset. -1 clears Shadowed. Any other preset sets Shadowed, ShadowColor (0,0,0,0.75), ShadowPos 0 and ShadowOffset 0.05; preset 1 additionally overwrites the colour with (1,1,1,0.75) from 00CEE07C. Presets 0 and 2 are indistinguishable.

routines.name: BSP_GuiText_SetLocalisedSource
routines.behaviour: Case-insensitive early-out against the cached narrow source at +F4h. Otherwise caches it, widens with 004C5E60 when the flag is clear or resolves with 00A9FAD0 when it is set, hands the UTF-16 result to 00ABA8D0, frees the temporary, and calls virtual +50h with this+50h, which is the base widget's four-float Color property.

routines.name: BSP_GuiText_SetAlpha
routines.behaviour: Base setter 00AA6980, then, when the shadow drawable +188h exists, multiplies the shadow alpha +174h by the incoming alpha and writes the product into the shadow material parameter at +0Ch.

routines.name: BSP_GuiText_SetColor
routines.behaviour: Base setter 00AA6870, then the same shadow-alpha scaling using the incoming colour's w lane at [arg+0Ch].

routines.name: BSP_GuiText_ApplyAlignToBounds
routines.convention: __thiscall(this, float* left, float* top, float* right, float* bottom)
routines.behaviour: Horizontal: w = +114h / 960 and p = the double at 00D5C5C8 (about 0.012). Mode 0 writes *right = *left + w + p; mode 2 writes *left = *right - w - p; mode 1 spreads w/2 + p around the midpoint of the pair; mode 3 leaves the rectangle alone because only 0, 1 and 2 are tested. Vertical: dispatches on +104h into 00AB6BD0.

routines.name: BSP_GuiText_SetSizeAndRebuild
routines.behaviour: Base size setter 00AA7970, then 00ABB1D0, which blanks +ECh and re-submits the saved copy so the wrap is recomputed against the new width.

routines.name: BSP_GuiText_RegisterClipParameters
routines.behaviour: For the main drawable +4Ch and the shadow drawable +188h, resolves the mesh through 00B74650 / 00B74640 / 00B732C0 and hands its +20h to BSP_UIContext_RegisterClipParameters, then walks the child list at +68h calling each child's virtual +70h.

Vtable +74h. Allocates a mesh object through BSP_MeshObject_AllocationContextEntry / BSP_MeshObject_Construct, installs it with BSP_GeneratedModel_SetGeometry, releases it, then calls BSP_GuiWidget_SetLocalPositionAndBounds with a zero vector. Why a Text widget needs a placeholder mesh at load time was not established, so no name was recorded.

routines.name: BSP_GuiText_PropagateStateToArrowIcons
routines.behaviour: Vtable +60h. Builds the literals __Active_Left_Icon and __Active_Right_Icon, finds both through BSP_GuiWidget_FindChildByName, frees the temporaries, and, only when both exist, calls each child's virtual +34h with its own argument. Provisional.

routines.name: BSP_GuiText_AllocateInstance
routines.behaviour: Single caller 00AA1380, which uses the returned pointer as the new Text object. Forwards to 00AB78A0, a fixed-size pooled allocator guarded by a critical section at +0Ch with a free list and 0x7E84-byte chunks. The Ghidra database tags this address cg_static_dtor_stub with high confidence; that tag is wrong.

routines.name: BSP_GuiPoints_DescribeProperties
routines.behaviour: Not the Text class. 00AAAED0 for the base half, then, when the pointer pair at +F0h/+F4h is non-empty, opens a 'Points' sub-object and emits one GuiValueTag 6 entry per 8-byte element under ascending integer keys starting at 1.

routines.name: BSP_GuiPoints_ReadProperties
routines.signature_source: Ghidra rendered it with the visitor as the only argument
routines.behaviour: Not the Text class. 00AAA710 for the base half, then, when the visitor's +14h predicate reports 'Points' present, descends and reads GuiValueTag 6 entries under ascending integer keys until the predicate fails, appending each through 004222C0.

describer_defect.finding: CMP dword ptr [EDI+160h], 1 is followed only by flag-preserving MOVs before the call at 00AB804E; no conditional consumes the flags. The describer always writes the literal Behind at 00D5C604, so a widget authored with ShadowPos = "Front" does not round-trip through describe. The reader is unaffected.

layout_contract.builder_selection: 00ABA8D0 reads +FCh: zero selects the single-line builder 00AB9FD0, nonzero selects the wrapped builder 00ABA270. Because the constructor stores 1, Multiline is an opt-out of wrapping.
layout_contract.container: Width is the base widget Size.x at +20h multiplied by the double 960 at 00CEC380 and truncated; height is Size.y at +24h.
layout_contract.scale: +1D8h (FontScale) is an extra horizontal scale on top of the font's own DAT scaling.
layout_contract.single_line_alignment: 00ABA100..00ABA148: modes 0 and 3 start at x = 0, mode 2 subtracts the measured width from the container width, mode 1 halves that difference.
layout_contract.wrapped_alignment: 00ABA270 applies +100h per line, with mode 3 distributing the slack across the line's spaces and falling back to left on the last line and on LF. It accumulates the per-line maximum into +114h and counts lines into +110h.
layout_contract.vertical_alignment: 00ABA270 uses +104h against the extent it stores at +178h: mode 0 leaves the origin, mode 1 centres it in Size.y, mode 2 bottom-aligns it.
layout_contract.line_advance: The pen advances by (+10Ch + k1 - k2) * lineHeight with the constants at 00D7A210 and 00CE6618. Both are read at ambiguous width by the decompiler and were not confirmed in the listing; the exact advance belongs to the font_wrapped_layout packet.
layout_contract.drawing: Glyph quads, the shadow section copy, the material parameters and the shadow placement (byte +15Ch gates the attachment, +168h..+174h reach the shadow material, +164h is scaled by the double 720 and placed by +160h) are already recorded in FONT_CONTEXT_OWNERSHIP.md and FONT_CONTEXT_MATERIAL_BINDINGS.md and are not restated here.

localisation.reader_flag: 00ABBD90 pushes the literal 1, so an authored DefaultText is always resolved through the localisation table.
localisation.split: 00A9FAD0 splits the source on '|' with _strcspn and resolves each piece with 00A9F4B0.
localisation.prefix: 00A9F4B0 strips one leading '^' before anything else and treats a leading '.' as a marker that suppresses the map lookup. What '^' means to the resolver is docs/APP_INIT_LOCALE.md open question 5 and was not settled here.
localisation.cache_key: The comparison in 00ABAED0 is on the source key, not the resolved text, so a language change alone does not invalidate a widget.

installed_file_check.method: Read-only regex scan of all 97 interface/*.lua files for ["Key"] = value forms. Values written as expressions or supplied by _common.lua helpers are not counted; those pages are the same ones the layout-loader's subset parser rejects.
consequences: The lower-case left, right and top spellings prove the case-insensitive comparison is load-bearing: five widgets would lose their alignment under a case-sensitive reader.
Multiline is only ever authored to turn wrapping off, so 275 of the 416 Text widgets take the wrapped builder by default.

DefaultShadow is authored on 348 widgets and the explicit Shadowed key on 5, which matches the reader's mutual exclusion. Because presets 0 and 2 are identical, 347 get the black (0,0,0,0.75) shadow and one gets white.
Only five font names are referenced in total, all resolvable through the registry lookup find_font_00ac3570 already models.
docs/GUI_LAYOUT_LOADER.md reports 248 Text widgets; that figure counts only the 70 pages its subset parser accepts, so the two numbers agree in kind.

uncertainties: +17Ch (constructor value 2) and +1F0h (constructor value true) have no reader or writer in the routines examined.
Where MISColors is consumed is unknown. No routine in the Text class reads +11Ch..+158h; the four names and the 60 authored occurrences suggest a screen-side state selector.
The wrapped line advance constants at 00D7A210 and 00CE6618 are read at ambiguous width by the decompiler and were not confirmed in the listing.
Virtual +60h (00AB87D0) and virtual +74h (00AB7700) are analysed but their roles are provisional.
The '^' prefix rule in 00A9F4B0 remains the locale packet's open question; this packet only establishes that the reader always requests localisation and that no shipped page uses the prefix.
Whether 00AB8C30 failing to trigger a re-layout is observable: changing Font at runtime without changing the text leaves stale glyph geometry.
The FontDescriptor member matched to the native font record's +1Ch is alpha_texture_scale, chosen by name and by its use in cOverbrightAlphatex; the offset was not re-derived here.

followups.contract: Who selects among MISColors.Normal/Focus/Selected/Disabled at +11Ch..+158h and how the chosen colour reaches virtual +50h.
The Points class mis-identified as Text: the GuiValueTag 6 point vector at +F0h/+F4h, the integer-key probe loop, and its instance size and class id.
Virtual +60h: what state the __Active_Left_Icon and __Active_Right_Icon children receive through their virtual +34h, and which screens author them.

reconstruction.build: scripts/build.ps1, Win32 Release, warnings as errors, clean
reconstruction.tests: ctest reconstructed_math passed; one focused case added to tests/math_tests.cpp covering the 00ABAED0 source cache and the 00A9F4B0 caret rule
reconstruction.scope: Struct layout with documented offsets, the two alignment enums as data, the shadow preset expander, the builder selection, the container width, the single-line start offset, the bounds rewrite, the localisation split, the source cache rule, the font-by-name setter, the set-text routine and the property binder over an injected GuiTextHost. No font layout, glyph or render code is duplicated.
